name: United States
description: Follow United States, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Warren presses U.S. companies to share tariff refunds with customers
changes.summary: Companies receiving billions in refunds for U.S. tariffs struck down by the Supreme Court should return money to consumers, Sen. Elizabeth Warren said.

changes.title: When tragedy strikes, America's wildland firefighters ask, was it 'somebody that we loved?'
changes.summary: Deaths and close calls while fighting wildfires have strained an already on-edge workforce. They've also raised questions about policies and priorities amid an intense wildfire season. (Image credit: Gretel Daugherty via AP).

changes.title: Employers unexpectedly cut 23,000 jobs in a sign of a wilting labor market
changes.summary: U.S. employers cut 23,000 jobs in July, and job gains for the two previous months were weaker than initially reported, according to a report Friday from the Labor Department. (Image credit: Joe Raedle).

changes.title: Tennessee voters oust Trump-backed congressman, set fall matchup for redrawn Memphis-area House seat
changes.summary: Former Tennessee Agriculture Commissioner Charlie Hatcher defeated U.S. Rep. Andy Ogles in a Republican primary Thursday for a significantly reshaped congressional district — marking a rare rejection of a candidate endorsed by President Donald Trump.

changes.title: U.S. employers unexpectedly cut 23,000 jobs amid strain from the Iran war, unemployment dips to 4.1%
changes.summary: U.S. employers unexpectedly cut 23,000 jobs last month, and Labor Department revisions shaved 103,000 jobs off payrolls in May and June. The unemployment rate dipped to 4.1% only because Americans left the job market.

changes.title: Why Mexican avocado exports to the U.S. have once again been stopped
changes.summary: Mexico began sending 1,500 more troops to the western state of Michoacan on Thursday, a day after the U.S. announced the suspension of government operations in that region — including halting avocado inspections required for their export — because of a non-specific threat to U.S. interests.

changes.title: Iranians Say Trump’s Promises Have Fallen by the Wayside as Iran War Drags On
changes.summary: As President Trump struggles to extricate the United States from the war in Iran, his promises to protesters in the country have fallen by the wayside.

changes.title: Ted Cruz says U.S. should arm Iranian protesters for an uprising. Is that plan realistic?
changes.summary: Texas Republican Sen. Ted Cruz says the U.S. should consider arming Iranian protesters so they can rise up against the regime. Alex Vatanka, a senior fellow at the Middle East Institute, reacts to the remarks.

changes.title: Will Mississippi send a Black Democrat to the US Senate? Scott Colom says don't count him out
changes.summary: Scott Colom is a Black man and a Democrat running for the U.S. Senate in Mississippi, a state traditionally led by white conservatives. Colom aims to unseat Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith, a white supporter of President Donald Trump who is seeking her second term.

changes.title: Appeals court rules Trump can't build White House ballroom without congressional approval
changes.summary: Trump said in a post on social media that he would be appealing what he called an "unjust decision" to the U.S. Supreme Court.
